title: I, Rogue
author: accidentalfish_
selftext:
I created this shader for rendering using ASCII a few months ago after seeing the Doom demo and wandering how it worked and my plan was to do something interesting with the gameplay but having struggled to find the fun in the things I did try I figured I'd just use it for traditional Rogue with some nice transitions.

You can play it here in the browser: [https://playablethings.com/i-rogue/](https://playablethings.com/i-rogue/)

Lots of options in the settings to play with the ASCII renderer.

Shader created by me, used Claude Code to piggy back it onto Rogue and do some of the nice transitions.
